build_StreamableConv1d: build a causal or symmetric Conv1d layer with built-in padding and normalization support
build_StreamableConvTranspose1d: build a transposed Conv1d layer with causal padding and configurable right trim ratio
build_NormConv1d: build a Conv1d layer wrapped with weight_norm, spectral_norm, or time_group_norm
build_NormConvTranspose1d: build a transposed Conv1d layer with optional normalization applied to weights
use_pad1d_and_unpad1d: use pad1d to pad a 1D tensor with reflect mode and unpad1d to remove padding
